name: vibestudio
description: VibeStudio: AI-first digital audio workstation (development workspace)

scripts.dev:backend: node scripts/py.mjs -m alembic upgrade head && node scripts/py.mjs -m uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.gen:schema: node scripts/py.mjs scripts/export_schema.py && npm --prefix frontend run gen:types
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format --check . && npm --prefix frontend run lint && npm --prefix frontend run format:check
scripts.format: node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff format . && node scripts/py.mjs -m ruff check --fix . && npm --prefix frontend run format
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
